subregion.name: Burial Hill
subregion.summary: The graveyard hill west of the road, tombstone rows and broken iron fence among aether crystals.

subregion.name: The dump flats
subregion.summary: Boggy ground at the dump's north end, cattail mud and beached boats among the first heaps of scrap.

subregion.name: The east mire
subregion.summary: The mire's eastern half, reed beds and lily pools under dead maples, with slith camps in the drier hummocks.

subregion.name: The east ridge

subregion.name: The grave road
subregion.summary: The road stretch below the dump, running past scattered graves and wrecked carts to the signpost fork.

subregion.name: The Hidden Path

subregion.name: The mire road
subregion.summary: The rutted road and the fieldstone wall beside it run south through the upper mire past slith totems and burrows.

subregion.name: The north shallows
subregion.summary: The mire's north edge, standing water and lily pads between rock outcrops, where the road and its fieldstone wall come in from the north.

subregion.name: The old dump
subregion.summary: Heaps of refuse and household wreck around the ruins of a burnt hamlet, with cave mouths cut into the banks.

subregion.name: The south crossing

subregion.name: The south mire
subregion.summary: The lower mire, where the road and the fieldstone wall drop south through waterlogged hollows toward the dump.

subregion.name: The west mire
subregion.summary: Drowned maple woods west of the road, boulders and rock cairns standing among the pools.
